inference.title: A100 · token DiT block (AF3 Alg. 23) · inference · d 768, cond 384, pair 128, 16 heads × 48, transition n = 2, bf16

panels.label: one step of a stack of blocks (A samples; each block's last residual pass fuses with the next block's AdaLN)

kernels.name: conditioning (once per step, every block)
code: ĉ = LN(cond)                              # statistics shared by every block's LN
G1 = ĉ @ W1'ᵀ + b1     # per block: scale, shift of the attention and the transition AdaLN
G2 = cond @ W2ᵀ + b2   # per block: the two output gates

kernels.name: pair bias (once per pair tensor)
code: p̂ = LN(pair)
bias = (Wf @ p̂ᵀ) · log2 e           # every block, head-major
bias[:, :, masked keys] = -inf

kernels.name: input + AdaLN
code: x = single                                  # the fp32 residual
xa = LN(x) · sigmoid(G1s) + G1b

kernels.name: q | k | v | g projection
code: qkvg = xa @ Wqkvgᵀ + b     # Wq, bq pre-scaled by sm_scale · log2 e

kernels.name: gated attention
code: s = q kᵀ + bias            # base 2, per sample and head
o = softmax(s) v
q ← sigmoid(g) · o         # written over q

kernels.name: output projection
code: y = (sigmoid(g) o) @ Woᵀ

kernels.name: residual + AdaLN
code: x += sigmoid(G2a) · y
xa = LN(x) · sigmoid(G1s') + G1b'            # the transition's AdaLN

kernels.name: expand
code: ab = xa @ [Wa; Wb]ᵀ

kernels.name: SwiGLU
code: h = silu(a) · b

kernels.name: squeeze
code: z = h @ Wsᵀ

kernels.name: residual (+ next block's AdaLN)
code: x += sigmoid(G2b) · z
xa = AdaLN(x) of the next block       # or out = x, the last block

training.title: A100 · token DiT block (AF3 Alg. 23) · training · d 768, cond 384, pair 128, 16 heads × 48, transition n = 2, bf16, A even

panels.label: forward (saves x, ĉ, G, Gg, xa, qkvg, o, lse, og, y, x1, xt, ab, z, p̂, bias)

kernels.name: conditioning
code: ĉ = LN(cond), c = bf16(cond)               # statistics saved
G = ĉ @ Wnᵀ        # s1 | sh1 | s2 | sh2, cond-LN weights folded into Wn
Gg = c @ Wgᵀ       # gate1 | gate2

kernels.name: AdaLN + projection
code: x = single (fp32); xa = LN(x) · sigmoid(G[:, :768] + bs1) + G[:, 768:1536]
qkvg = xa @ Wqkvgᵀ + b

kernels.name: pair bias
code: p̂ = LN(pair)                                # statistics saved
bias = (Wf @ p̂ᵀ).view(16, L, L)            # natural units; masked keys = -inf

kernels.name: attention forward
code: s = sm_scale q kᵀ + bias; o = softmax(s) v   # fp32 o
lse = log2 Σ exp2(s · log2 e)               # per sample, head, query

kernels.name: gate, output projection, residual, AdaLN
code: og = sigmoid(g) · o;  y = og @ Woᵀ
x1 = x + sigmoid(Gg[:, :768] + bg1) · y

kernels.name: transition + output
code: ab = xt @ [Wa; Wb]ᵀ;  h = silu(a) · b;  z = h @ Wsᵀ
out = x1 + sigmoid(Gg[:, 768:] + bg2) · z

panels.label: backward; dqkvg = [dq | dk | dv | dg], one buffer; the attention kernels read the saved bias, lse and the row term D

kernels.name: output side
code: dz = dout; dGg[:, 768:] and the bg2 sum from z
dh = dz @ Ws;  dWs = dzᵀ @ h

kernels.name: SwiGLU backward + expand
code: dab = swiglu'(ab) · dh   (h recomputed for dWs)
dxt = dab @ [Wa; Wb];  d[Wa; Wb] = dabᵀ @ xt

kernels.name: residual + AdaLN backward
code: dx1 = dout + LN backward(dxt · sigmoid')
dy = dx1 · sigmoid(gate1);  dG, dGg, bs2 / bg1 sums

kernels.name: output projection + gate backward
code: dog = dy @ Wo;  dWo = dyᵀ @ og
dO = dog · sigmoid(g);  D = Σ_d dO o;  dg = dog · o · sigmoid'(g)

kernels.name: attention backward, query side
code: P = exp2(scl q kᵀ + bias log2 e − lse);  dS = P (dO vᵀ − D)
dq = sm_scale dS k;  db[h, i, j] = Σ_a dS   # 4 samples per CTA, then a fixed-order reduce

kernels.name: attention backward, key side
code: Pᵀ = exp2(scl k qᵀ + biasᵀ log2 e − lse);  dSᵀ = Pᵀ (v dOᵀ − D)
dv = Pᵀ dO;  dk = sm_scale dSᵀ q

kernels.name: q | k | v gradient, projection backward, AdaLN backward
code: dqkvg[:, :2304] = bf16(dq | dk | dv);  bq sum
dxa = dqkvg @ Wqkvg;  dWqkvg = dqkvgᵀ @ xa
dx = dx1 + LN backward(dxa · sigmoid');  dG

kernels.name: conditioning + pair-bias backward
code: dĉ = dG @ Wn;  dWn = dGᵀ @ ĉ;  dcond, dW1 / dW2, d(LN_cond weight)
dWf = db @ p̂;  dp̂ = dbᵀ @ Wf;  dpair = LN backward(dp̂)

hbm.name: dout, dsingle, dx1, dy, dog, dO
